## Ticket

`docs/tickets/489c_P37.61c__projection-out-of-commit-path.md` — manifest row
489c (Round 11 / P37, sub-round 11D), under operator **RULING E-2** (GATE
DECISIONS 2026-11-15; `docs/build/readouts/RULINGS-2026-11-15.md`):
*"Stop committing the generated projection, and stop gating every records
commit on its freshness."* Live verification explicitly disabled — no live
legs, no production mutation, `main` untouched.

## What this changes

- **ADR-250** (amends ADR-126's committed-output posture only): the
  deterministic current-state projection is generated on demand and is
  **never committed**. `current_projection.py` is unchanged as a tool —
  `generate`/`verify` and every semantic check stay.
- **Committed output removed:** `docs/build/reports/current/` (14 generated
  files) leaves the tree in **one commit** (`2f64b345`). Every input —
  `reports/obligations/`, LEDGER, DEFERRALS, BUILD_INDEX, matrix — stays.
- **CI `docs` job:** the projection step is now
  `make docs-check-projection PROJ_OUT="${{ runner.temp }}/current-projection"`
  — the recipe runs `obligation_events.py check` then literally
  `generate --out <tmp> && verify --out <tmp>`, and the temp output is
  uploaded as the `current-state-projection` workflow artifact
  (`upload-artifact@v7`, `if: !cancelled()`). Red on generation failure,
  unresolved inconsistencies, bad landing refs, uncovered inputs, budget
  violations — exactly as before; "committed output drifted" can no longer
  fire.
- **Readers repointed:** `Makefile docs-check-projection` (temp-dir leg,
  `PROJ_OUT` override), `ci.yml`, root `AGENTS.md`, `tests/AGENTS.md`
  (`reports/current/` out of the living-path list; `reports/obligations/`
  stays), `docs/build/README.md`,
  `docs/build/reports/OPERATING_MODE_R11.md` (closeout no longer regens),
  `living_records.toml` + the pinned lint example, dead
  `CURRENT_PROJECTION` constant in `personal_id_rekey.py`, the tool's
  docstring, `.gitignore` (the default out dir is now scratch),
  `COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv` SIG-MEM-002 evidence ref → ADR-250,
  `BACKLOG.csv` BL-087 names ADR-250 (md regenerated), `.agents` dispatch
  note marked superseded, `test_ci_docs_job_names_the_new_gates` +
  `test_agent_docs_current_state` invariants updated.
  `perf_reuse.py` needed no change (`docs/build/**` minus `tools/` was
  already records-class).
- **Sanctioned deletion:** `history.policy` declares `seed-commit 2f64b345`
  in a later commit of this PR (the `427c5efb` precedent) — the deleted
  paths classify to no protected record class, so the declaration records
  the sanction RULING E-2 requires rather than covering real findings.
- **Spec pipeline:** ADR-250 via `spec_src/99a_appF_adr.md` + `BUILD.sh`
  byte-identical rebuild; `check_spec_src.py` 0 (248/248 ADRs);
  `adr-index.sh` regen; `ADR_TRIGGERS.csv` BL-087 row appended (hash of the
  trigger text, quiet at authoring). ADR-126 amended by an append-only
  `Status:` entry.

## G10-retired violations

This ticket changes checks that judge its own PR. The retired items, each
created-and-retired by this PR per the contract:

| check | retired behaviour | successor |
|---|---|---|
| `current_projection.py verify` (CI `docs` job, committed path) | failing the job when the committed `reports/current/` output drifted or was absent — every records commit owed a regen | `verify` still runs, against `runner.temp` output — drift against a committed file cannot occur because no committed file exists |
| `test_ci_docs_job_names_the_new_gates` | required the literal string `current_projection.py verify` inside the `docs` job | same test now asserts the invariant: temp-dir `generate && verify` via `docs-check-projection`, no `|| true`, artifact upload, no committed-path reference |

Nothing else is waived. The `memory_guard` deletion findings: **none
produced** — the removed paths carry no protected record class
(`--range` verdict clean before and after the declaration).
